title: [4.4.1-stable][.NET] Android app crashes at startup
body:
### Tested versions

Tested Versions:

4.4.1-stable
4.4.1-rc2

.NET 9
.NET 8



### System information

Godot v4.4.1.stable.mono - Windows 11 (build 26100) - Vulkan (Forward+) 

### Issue description

Android app crashes at startup

### Steps to reproduce

When the Android app crashes at startup, it happens unexpectedly for the first time.  After the 1st crash, subsequent loading of the app also crashes at startup.  After the 1st crash, even rebuilding and doing subsequent remote deploying with Gradle build, the app also crashes on the Android.  To fix the crashing at startups, I would have to manually uninstall the app from the Android device, and then do a remote deploy.

There is a certain odd behavior that I noticed when the 1st crash happens.  Using remote deploy with Gradle build  when developing throughout the day, the app works fine.  But when I disconnect the Android device from my computer at the end of the day, and then try to start the app the next morning (8+ hours had passed), that is when the 1st crash happens.  This behavior has happened twice.

Here are some of the logs from the command 'adb logcat|grep godot'
